dct_description_sm: Contributors: Doelling, Hellmut H., 1930- creator.; Kuehne, Paul A., creator.; Sprinkel, Douglas A., creator.; Utah Geological Survey. cartographer.
Includes quadrangle location map, index map.
Plate 2 includes geologic symbols, correlation of units, lithologic column.
Project manager: Donald L. Clark ; GIS and cartography: Paul A. Kuehne and Lori J. Steadman.
Publication statement: Salt Lake City, Utah : Utah Geological Survey, 2016.
Relief shown by contours and spot heights.
System requirements: Adobe Acrobat reader. Specialized GIS software is required to use the GIS files.

This CD contains GIS files in ESRI file geodatabase and shapefile formats. Also included in PDF format are 2 plates -- a geologic map with an explanation plate -- and a 14 page booklet describing the geology of the quadrangle.
dct_title_s: Geologic map of the Ephraim quadrangle, Sanpete County, Utah
